LanguageData.ANB.SurnameFatherTip: Use the father's last name. Falls back to the mother, then the birth parent, if needed.
LanguageData.ANB.SurnameMotherTip: Use the mother's last name. Falls back to the father, then the birth parent, if needed.
LanguageData.ANB.SurnameRandomTip: Pick randomly among the parents' last names, matching vanilla.
LanguageData.ANB.SurnameIdeologyTip: Use the parents' Ideology marriage name precept instead of a fixed last-name rule. Always or usually the man's name uses the father's surname; always or usually the woman's name uses the mother's. Keep names and random pick among the parents.
